# Auto-generated figure captions

Numbers come straight from the data; edit the wording, not the numbers.

**01_npo_cfd_vs_experiment** - Power number versus Reynolds number, CFD (45 points) and experiment (24 speeds, 44–347 RPM, torque as measured; error bars = the two torque readings per speed). Fluid: ρ = 996.3 kg/m³, μ = 0.000854 Pa·s; impeller D = 0.14028 m. The CFD falls steeply towards low N_Re; the shaded region (N_Re < 4000) is not used for the plateau. Turbulent range on a linear N_Po axis. CFD plateau (N_Re ≥ 4000): 0.70 ± 0.02. Experiment at N_Re ≥ 100000: 1.03 ± 0.01. CFD-to-experiment ratio of N_Po at the experimental Reynolds numbers (CFD interpolated in log–log). Mean 0.50 ± 0.13 over 11 points; range 0.28–0.64. Torque versus Reynolds number, CFD and experiment. In the experiment torque follows N_Re² (turbulent). The CFD torque is nearly constant for N_Re ≤ 100 and only joins the N_Re² trend at higher N_Re, so the CFD N_Po at low N_Re is dominated by that constant torque.

**individual/01a_npo_vs_nre_full** - Power number versus Reynolds number, CFD (45 points) and experiment (24 speeds, 44–347 RPM, torque as measured; error bars = the two torque readings per speed). Fluid: ρ = 996.3 kg/m³, μ = 0.000854 Pa·s; impeller D = 0.14028 m. The CFD falls steeply towards low N_Re; the shaded region (N_Re < 4000) is not used for the plateau.

**individual/01b_npo_plateau** - Turbulent range on a linear N_Po axis. CFD plateau (N_Re ≥ 4000): 0.70 ± 0.02. Experiment at N_Re ≥ 100000: 1.03 ± 0.01.

**individual/01c_ratio_cfd_over_exp** - CFD-to-experiment ratio of N_Po at the experimental Reynolds numbers (CFD interpolated in log–log). Mean 0.50 ± 0.13 over 11 points; range 0.28–0.64.

**individual/01d_torque_vs_nre** - Torque versus Reynolds number, CFD and experiment. In the experiment torque follows N_Re² (turbulent). The CFD torque is nearly constant for N_Re ≤ 100 and only joins the N_Re² trend at higher N_Re, so the CFD N_Po at low N_Re is dominated by that constant torque.

**individual/02_experiment_torque_vs_rpm** - Experimental torque versus shaft speed with a quadratic fit τ = 0.0074 + 2.391e-06·RPM² (R² = 0.9999); error bars = the two readings per speed.
